title: Creative Portfolio
description: Build a creative portfolio with project selection, presentation design, and online presence for showcasing your work.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations
modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for Creative Portfolio.

content.text: Welcome to Lesson 1 of Creative Portfolio. In this lesson, you'll learn about Creative Process—a fundamental concept in Creative Arts.
Core Concept: Creative Process
Every great creative portfolio practitioner starts with understanding Creative Process. This lesson walks you through the key ideas, common mistakes, and a practical example you can try today.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: The most successful practitioners in Creative Arts always practice Creative Process before moving to more advanced topics.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Creative Process without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main purpose of Creative Process in Creative Portfolio?
content.explanation: The goal of Creative Process is to build a solid foundation you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Creative Process to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
